title: Semantic & Context-Aware Planning V1 — PlanningContextEnvelope (advisory, provenance-bound) wired at the two async planner seams, deterministic EN/VI normalization + coverage extension, advisory semantic_hints verified by assertPlanCoverage, persisted coverage/explainability evidence
description: Per docs/plans/2026-10-26-semantic-context-planning-v1.md (adjusted from owner mission, codex-planner review SOUND_WITH_ADJUSTMENTS). B'/F': PlanningContextEnvelope — advisory provenance-bound context snapshot (CANONICAL|PROVEN|PROJECTED|UNVERIFIED sections; volatile-stripped context_digest) assembled only via existing owner-gated/tenancy-admitted read paths, wired at the two async model seams (planExpander + runReplanPoolGeneration) with digest persisted as evidence — never bound into effective_input_digest/plan_digest, never a gate. C'/D': deterministic EN/VI normalization gap-fill (lexemes, paraphrase tables, subject anchors) + coverage matcher extension; optional model semantic_hints ride inside the existing planner response on the same transport (zero new provider invocations) and remain advisory — assertPlanCoverage stays the sole PROVEN authority. E': bounded envelope sections rendered into the single canonical prompt builder shared by both transports. G': PlanCoverageReport + envelope digest persisted on attempt/preview evidence, read-only UI projection. H': adversarial corpus incl. VI paraphrase, wrong-target, quantity/temporal mismatch, negation, context injection, cross-business isolation, sync-boundary and hint-forgery probes. I': real-model E2E gated on live codex qualification else BLOCKED_REAL_MODEL. No model call inside the synchronous canonicalizer contract; no auto-merge.
